description: PaySilo Multi-Employer Payroll Executor (Starter Kit 6) on AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime

gateway.name: paysilo-airwallex-tools
gateway.note: AgentCore Gateway exposes the Airwallex tool surface (balances, FX, transfers, charges) as Lambda/REST targets. Employer-scoped calls still go over REST with x-on-behalf-of — MCP/Gateway cannot act on behalf of a connected account — so the gateway is an observability and tooling layer, not the money path.

memory.note: LangGraph checkpoints: MemorySaver locally; Postgres checkpointer (DATABASE_URL) on AgentCore so interrupted approval/escalation runs survive restarts.

name: paysilo-payroll-agent

observability.note: AgentCore Observability (CloudWatch) receives the same audit events the graph appends to state['audit'], so the deployed agent's decisions replay exactly like the local demo.
